text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The final straight!
Which Umamusume will pull ahead?!

text_block_list.name: Rudolf & C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Kh...! This is even more than the Japan Cup!
An unbelievable pressure is bearing down on me!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Still...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Like hell I'm gonna look back...!!
Like hell I'm going down without a fight...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (I will... keep moving... "forward"...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Look at me!! This is how I live!! Try and catch me!! This is my—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's the run of an "Ace"!!!!!
(————*THUDDDDDDDDD!*)

text_block_list.name: Rudolf & C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOOOAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In the lead is Katsuragi Ace!!
It's Katsuragi Ace!!
Katsuragi Ace crosses the finish line in the lead!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeahhh!!!
Just as planned!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!! It wasn't a fluke...!!
Is Katsuragi Ace the real deal...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No way... My heart was pounding so fast...!!
So this is how Japan's "Ace" runs...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
......A complete defeat once again, huh.
And yet—my heart feels as clear as a fresh spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Following her example, I too shall hone myself.
The strength within me to overcome adversity...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Next time, I've really gotta step it up, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Guess I'll have to show 'em who Ace's number one rival really is.

(Ace!! Ace!! Ace!!
Ace!! Ace!! Ace!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa... What an incredible sight...--

She defeated both Symboli Rudolf and Mr. C.B. twice,
and what's more, across different distances.
No one anywhere doubts Katsuragi Ace's true strength anymore after her victory at the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Ace's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Es-cchiiii!! Congrats----!!
Ace-chaaan!! Congrats----!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace!!!
Congratulations!!!!
(Congrats!! Thank you!! I'm so moved!! You're the strongest!! Thank you, Ace!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: “—Now then, let's hear a few words from Katsuragi Ace, who conquered this year's Arima Kinen!”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Umm—
First off, to everyone who supported me!!
Thank you so, so much!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Up until today, I've just been recklessly running, always looking forward."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Running headfirst into harsh realities,
stopping dead in my tracks time and time again,
watching my sweat drip onto the ground over and over—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, I...—
I just couldn't bear to accept reality without fighting back,
so I kept struggling with everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—The world is cruel.
The cards everyone is dealt are decided the moment they are born,
with no choice in the matter.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No matter how weak, how few, or how battered
your cards are, you have no choice but to fight with them.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"That's just the rules,"
reality thrusts upon us.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Like I'd just accept the hand I was dealt, give up on that dazzling view in the distance as 'another world,' and come to a halt!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Defying destiny, searching for a path to victory,
screaming that there's no "other world,"
and fighting desperately to push forward!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Which one to choose...
that's for us to decide for ourselves!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I choose...!! To fight!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as impossible, no 'different world'!!
Anyone can fight!!
We can keep on fighting!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"As the rebellious 'Ace' who shatters destiny!!
With my running!! I'll keep proving it!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And—to anyone fighting right now!
To everyone who wants to defy their fate!!
I'll cheer for every single one of you!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's fight through this moment together!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "I'll stay right here and keep fighting along with everyone, too!!!"
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: …………I've decided what I'm gonna do next!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a coincidence.
...I've made up my mind, too.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Shall we fight?
—All of us, each walking our own path.

text_block_list.name: Fighter A
text_block_list.text: ……Maybe I should just take the plunge and change jobs.

text_block_list.name: Fighter A
text_block_list.text: I just can't give up on my dream after all...!

text_block_list.name: Fighter B
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, Mom? Did you see my LANE message?
Yeah. I decided not to come home.
...Yeah. I want to keep trying a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Fighter B
text_block_list.text:
...I'm okay. I won't overdo it.
My vision is super clear right now.
Plus... I'm fired up with a 'like hell I'll lose!' spirit.
And so, the Arima Kinen—where Katsuragi Ace ignited countless hearts with her true "Ace" style—came to an end...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Yeeaaaahhhhh!!!
'Best Senior Umamusume' is miiiiine!!!
We did it, Traineeeer!!!
Later on, Katsuragi Ace's remarkable performance earned her the title of "Best Senior-Class Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!!

As Katsuragi Ace and I rejoiced together
to the point of tears—

"Japan's Ace and the World's <username>
Celebrate Best Senior Umamusume Award!" ...it says!

It was reported to the world alongside a photo
of Katsuragi Ace and me, both flashing beaming smiles
as we high-fived.
